preconditions.description: The dimensions of the matrix w must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements of the matrix w must be non-negative integers within the specified range.

postconditions.description: Output 'NO' if the matrix w cannot be obtained by the given rules, otherwise output 'YES'.
If valid, the output k must be a positive integer within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= ai <= 10**18 for ai in a)
postconditions.description: If valid, the output array a must have n elements, each within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: len(b) == m and all(0 <= bi <= 10**18 for bi in b)
postconditions.description: If valid, the output array b must have m elements, each within the specified range.
